_comment: DRAFT (Story 3.7, decision log K-14..K-19): the day clock's words, for Raphael to rewrite. phase_names: the HUD clock's phase word ('20:40 · Evening'; the hall's top bar and the exterior's corner clock). too_early + sleep_from: the bedroom's Sleep button before day_clock.sleep_from_hour ('It's too early to sleep. (from 20:00)'). last_call: the banner at 23:00 (the hall only). closing: the banner when the guests not yet served go home (the hall only). tired: the banner at 1:00 (anywhere). nod_off: the line at 2:00 (a banner in the hall; on the black screen outside). The code holds the same words as defaults (scripts/game/day_clock_rules.gd TEXT_DEFAULTS).
tired: It's late. Find your bed, or you'll fall asleep where you stand.
nod_off: You nod off where you stand…
